name: setup
js: (() => { document.getElementById('setupDialog').close(); window.__calls = []; const g = GMMC; g.exportAct = (a) => { window.__calls.push(a); }; Element.prototype.setPointerCapture = function () {}; g.setLayout('schematic'); g.fit(); return { layout: g.getSettings().layout, stations: Object.keys(g.getMap().stations).length, lines: g.getMap().lines.length }; })()

name: boxselect
js: (() => { const svg = document.getElementById('map'), r = svg.getBoundingClientRect(); const ev = (type, x, y, extra) => svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, Object.assign({ bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerId: 5, button: 0, shiftKey: true, pointerType: 'mouse' }, extra || {}))); GMMC.setTool('select'); ev('pointerdown', r.left + 4, r.top + 4); ev('pointermove', r.left + r.width / 2, r.top + r.height / 2); const mid = !!document.querySelector('.ed-box'); ev('pointermove', r.right - 4, r.bottom - 4); ev('pointerup', r.right - 4, r.bottom - 4); const s = GMMC.getSelection(); return { boxShown: mid, boxGone: !document.querySelector('.ed-box'), type: s && s.type, count: s && s.ids.length }; })()

name: smallbox
js: (() => { const svg = document.getElementById('map'), r = svg.getBoundingClientRect(); const ev = (type, x, y) => svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerId: 6, button: 0, shiftKey: true, pointerType: 'mouse' })); const cx = r.left + r.width / 2, cy = r.top + r.height / 2; ev('pointerdown', cx - 120, cy - 120); ev('pointermove', cx + 120, cy + 120); ev('pointerup', cx + 120, cy + 120); const s = GMMC.getSelection(); return { count: s ? s.ids.length : 0 }; })()

name: copypaste
js: (() => { const m = GMMC.getMap(); const k = (key) => document.getElementById('map').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); const sel0 = GMMC.getSelection().ids.length; const st0 = Object.keys(m.stations).length, ln0 = m.lines.length; k('c'); k('v'); const m2 = GMMC.getMap(); const sel = GMMC.getSelection(); return { copiedSelection: sel0, stationsBefore: st0, stationsAfter: Object.keys(m2.stations).length, linesBefore: ln0, linesAfter: m2.lines.length, pastedSelected: sel.ids.length, allNewIds: sel.ids.every(id => m2.stations[id]), sample: m2.stations[sel.ids[0]].name }; })()

name: undo
js: (() => { const b = Object.keys(GMMC.getMap().stations).length; GMMC.undo(); return { before: b, afterUndo: Object.keys(GMMC.getMap().stations).length }; })()

name: paletteOpen
js: (() => { document.getElementById('map').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'k', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); const d = document.getElementById('edPalette'); return { open: d.open, items: d.querySelectorAll('li[data-i]').length, focus: document.activeElement.id }; })()

name: paletteSearch
js: (() => { const i = document.getElementById('edPInput'); i.value = 'union'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return [...document.querySelectorAll('#edPList li')].slice(0, 5).map(l => l.textContent); })()

name: paletteDown
js: (() => { const i = document.getElementById('edPInput'); i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'ArrowDown', bubbles: true })); return document.querySelector('#edPList li[aria-selected=true]').textContent; })()

name: paletteGoStation
js: (() => { const i = document.getElementById('edPInput'); i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); const s = GMMC.getSelection(); return { closed: !document.getElementById('edPalette').open, sel: s && s.type, id: s && s.ids && GMMC.getMap().stations[s.ids[0]].name, k: GMMC.getView().k }; })()

name: paletteExport
js: (() => { document.getElementById('map').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'k', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); const i = document.getElementById('edPInput'); i.value = 'PNG'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); return { calls: window.__calls, closed: !document.getElementById('edPalette').open }; })()

name: paletteRoute
js: (() => { document.getElementById('map').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'k', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); const i = document.getElementById('edPInput'); i.value = 'go to route'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); const n = document.querySelectorAll('#edPList li[data-i]').length; i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); const s = GMMC.getSelection(); return { routesListed: n, sel: s && s.type, line: s && GMMC.lineById(s.id).name }; })()

name: paletteLayoutFreq
js: (() => { const open = (q) => { document.getElementById('map').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'k', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); const i = document.getElementById('edPInput'); i.value = q; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); }; const f0 = GMMC.getSettings().showFreq; open('toggle freq'); const f1 = GMMC.getSettings().showFreq; open('layout: geo'); const lay = GMMC.getSettings().layout; open('layout: schem'); return { freqToggled: f0 !== f1, geoLayout: lay, back: GMMC.getSettings().layout }; })()

name: paletteToggleClose
js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('edPalette'); document.getElementById('map').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'k', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); const was = d.open; document.getElementById('map').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'k', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return { opened: was, ctrlKAgainCloses: !d.open }; })()

name: pinch
js: (() => { GMMC.fit(); const svg = document.getElementById('map'), r = svg.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = r.left + r.width / 2, cy = r.top + r.height / 2; const ev = (type, id, x, y) => svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerId: id, button: 0, pointerType: 'touch', isPrimary: id === 11 })); const k0 = GMMC.getView().k; ev('pointerdown', 11, cx - 60, cy); ev('pointerdown', 12, cx + 60, cy); ev('pointermove', 11, cx - 120, cy); ev('pointermove', 12, cx + 120, cy); return new Promise(res => setTimeout(() => { const k1 = GMMC.getView().k; ev('pointermove', 11, cx - 30, cy); ev('pointermove', 12, cx + 30, cy); setTimeout(() => { const k2 = GMMC.getView().k; ev('pointerup', 12, cx + 30, cy); ev('pointerup', 11, cx - 30, cy); res({ k0, afterSpread: k1, afterPinchIn: k2, spreadZoomsIn: k1 > k0 * 1.8, pinchInZoomsOut: k2 < k1 }); }, 100); }, 100)); })()

name: pinchNoStuckDrag
js: (() => { const v = GMMC.getView(), k = v.k, tx = v.tx; document.getElementById('map').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { bubbles: true, clientX: 100, clientY: 100, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse' })); return { unchanged: GMMC.getView().tx === tx && GMMC.getView().k === k }; })()

name: colourblind
js: (() => { const out = {}; document.getElementById('settingsBtn').click(); const sel = document.getElementById('edCbSelect'); out.hasSelect = !!sel; out.label = document.querySelector('.ed-settings .tf-label').textContent; for (const v of ['prot', 'deut', 'trit', 'none']) { sel.value = v; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); out[v] = document.getElementById('map').style.filter || '(none)'; } sel.value = 'deut'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return out; })()

name: issues
js: (() => { const m = GMMC.getMap(); m.lines[0].color = '#ffff00'; m.lines[1].color = '#c8102f'; m.lines[2].color = '#c8102e'; GMMC.renderPanels(); return [...document.querySelectorAll('#issueList li')].map(l => l.textContent).filter(s => /white|nearly|白色|一樣/.test(s)); })()
